name: expanso-fleet
description: See your Expanso nodes, jobs, executions, and pipeline health from ChatGPT.

interface.shortDescription: Your Expanso jobs, nodes, and pipeline health
interface.longDescription: Open a Fleet view of your Expanso workspace, mention jobs and nodes with @, and ask why a job is degraded. The plugin reads node connectivity, job and execution state, state history, and a bounded snapshot of recent job logs. It cannot deploy, stop, or change anything.
defaultPrompt: What jobs do I have on the network?
Which nodes are healthy and which are not?
What is failing right now, and why?
